text:
Adam Fantilli told the Columbus Dispatch he's "not nervous at all" about his slow start, and he has reason to be calm. He's playing almost 21 minutes a night and has four goals, but only six points in 16 games, and he's pointless in six.

The worry is that the chances have thinned out during this stretch, not just the finishing. Columbus is a little under even at five on five with him on (48% of the expected goals). Evolving-Hockey flagged last season that opponents got more chances with him on the ice (bottom 6% of forwards), and that's still the piece of his game to grow.

The skill hasn't gone anywhere. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him in the 93rd percentile for chances from the slot, carrying in 58% of his entries. The third overall pick in 2023 is 22. Our range has him at 20 to 35 goals, which assumes the chances come back.
